overview: A visit count tells you little. What shoppers do on the page tells you a lot. faq: How do you decide which events to track?
We start with your questions, such as where shoppers drop off or which products get added but not bought. Then we choose the events that answer them. Tracking everything just creates noise.
Will events work with my theme?
Yes. We use your platform's built-in data where it exists and add small, tested snippets where it does not. If a custom theme blocks tracking, we explain what must change first.
Can I see the events straight away?
Yes. In Google Analytics, events appear in the live view within minutes and in standard reports after a day or so. We show you where to look and how to read each one.
What if I change my theme later?
Events built on theme code may need a quick recheck. Ones built in Tag Manager with a data layer usually survive. The document we give you lists exactly what depends on what.
